[[File:Galvatron Relic.png|thumb|220x220px|]]
The '''Galvatron Relics''' are Relics awarded by completely exploring the [[Galvatron Rising]] Special Missions. Unlike previous Relics, each tier has its own name and appearance.

== Description ==
''A tribute to a [[Galvatron|Bot]] more violent than [[Megatron]] who plots to lead the Decepticons. Awarded for mastery of the Easy/Medium/Hard/Expert Galvatron Rising Special Mission.''

== Relic Boosts ==
* (Green): +1% Attack and Health in Alliance Missions
* Bronze:  +2%
* Silver:    +3%
* Gold:     +4%
